Osseointegration of Ti6Al4V scaffolds produced by selective laser melting (SLM) after surface treatment

Rosifini Alves Claro Ana Paula, Bastos Jaqueline, Oliveira Liliane, Machado Alessandra, Lopes Ricardo et al. Frontiers in Bioengineering and Biotechnology 2016-01-01 10.3389/conf.fbioe.2016.01.00706
相关性: 该论文直接研究了SLM制造的Ti6Al4V支架经表面处理后的骨整合性能，与用户关于增材制造生物医学材料及骨结合的方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not explicitly address stress shielding or fatigue behavior, and may lack detailed stiffness matching analysis.
动机· 评估SLM制造Ti6Al4V支架经表面处理后的骨整合效果。
方法· 使用选择性激光熔化制备多孔Ti6Al4V支架，并进行表面处理。
结果· 表面处理显著促进了支架的骨整合能力。
验证· 通过动物体内植入实验验证骨整合性能。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the osseointegration of Ti6Al4V scaffolds fabricated by selective laser melting after surface treatment.
Method· Ti6Al4V scaffolds were manufactured via selective laser melting and subsequently subjected to surface treatment.
Result· The surface treatment significantly enhanced osseointegration of the scaffolds.
Validation· Osseointegration was validated through in vivo animal implantation experiments.

Reconstruction of the Upper Cervical Spine Using a Personalized 3D-Printed Vertebral Body in an Adolescent With Ewing Sarcoma.

Nanfang Xu, Feng Wei, Xiaoguang Liu, Liang Jiang, Hong Cai et al. Spine 2016-01-01 10.1097/BRS.0000000000001179
单位: Department of Orthopaedics, Peking University Third Hospital, Beijing, China.
相关性: 该论文展示了3D打印钛合金个性化椎体在颈椎重建中的临床应用，但缺少对LPBF工艺、力学性能测试及应力遮挡等核心问题的分析。
边界: No LPBF characterization, no mechanical testing (fatigue or static), no explicit stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis.
动机· 为青少年尤文肉瘤患者定制3D打印颈椎椎体并评估临床效果
方法· 采用钛合金粉末3D打印定制C2椎体假体，植入C1-C3间隙
结果· 患者术后1年肿瘤无复发，假体骨整合良好，无下沉移位
验证· 临床随访和CT影像评估
English summary & terms
Motivation· To describe a personalized 3D-printed vertebral body for upper cervical spine reconstruction after Ewing sarcoma resection in an adolescent.
Method· A custom titanium alloy vertebral body was fabricated using 3D printing based on patient CT data and implanted after tumor resection.
Result· The patient had uneventful recovery, was tumor-free at 1-year follow-up, and showed implant osseointegration on CT with no subsidence or displacement.
Validation· Clinical case report with 1-year follow-up and CT imaging.

3D printed Ti6Al4V implant surface promotes bone maturation and retains a higher density of less aged osteocytes at the bone-implant interface.

Furqan A Shah, Anders Snis, Aleksandar Matic, Peter Thomsen, Anders Palmquist Acta biomaterialia 2016-01-01 10.1016/j.actbio.2015.11.013
单位: Department of Biomaterials, Institute of Clinical Sciences, Sahlgrenska Academy at University of Gothenburg, Göteborg, Sweden; BIOMATCELL VINN Excellence Center of Biomaterials and Cell Therapy, Göteb
通讯: Furqan A Shah @ Department of Biomaterials, Institute of Clinical Sciences, Sahlgrenska Academy at University of Gothenburg, Göteborg, S
相关性: 该论文研究了3D打印多孔Ti6Al4V植入物对骨成熟和骨细胞密度的影响，但未涉及机械性能测试或疲劳行为。
边界: No mechanical testing (compression, fatigue, or stiffness matching) was performed; the study focused solely on biological bone-implant interface characterization.
动机· 评估3D打印多孔Ti6Al4V植入物对骨整合和应力遮挡的影响。
方法· 在成年绵羊股骨中植入3D打印实心和多孔Ti6Al4V植入物，愈合6个月后通过拉曼光谱和电镜分析界面组织。
结果· 多孔植入物界面骨成熟更先进，骨细胞密度更高，骨细胞形态更年轻。
验证· 绵羊体内实验验证了骨整合效果。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of 3D printed porous Ti6Al4V implants on bone integration and stress-shielding mitigation.
Method· Solid and macro-porous Ti6Al4V implants fabricated by 3D printing were implanted in adult sheep femora for six months, and the bone-implant interface was analyzed using Raman spectroscopy and electron microscopy.
Result· Porous implants promoted more advanced bone maturation, higher osteocyte density, and a less aged osteocyte morphology at the interface.
Validation· In vivo sheep model validated the biological response and osseointegration.

Bioactive treatment promotes osteoblast differentiation on titanium materials fabricated by selective laser melting technology

Masako Tsukanaka, Shunsuke Fujibayashi, Mitsuru Takemoto, Tomiharu Matsushita, Tadashi Kokubo et al. Dental Materials Journal 2016-01-01 10.4012/dmj.2015-127
单位: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Graduate School of Medicine, Kyoto University
通讯: Masako Tsukanaka @ Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Graduate School of Medicine, Kyoto University
相关性: 该论文研究了SLM制备钛的表面粗糙度和生物活性处理对成骨分化的影响，但缺少力学测试和应力屏蔽分析。
边界: This paper does not address stress shielding, porosity optimization, or mechanical testing (fatigue, compression) for SLM-fabricated implants; it focuses solely on biological response to surface roughness and bioactive coating.
动机· 研究SLM制造钛表面的粗糙度和生物活性处理对成骨细胞分化的影响
方法· 以SLM制造钛片（Ra=24.58 µm）和轧制钛片（Ra=1.02 µm）进行对比，并施加生物活性处理
结果· SLM粗糙表面需经生物活性处理才能促进成骨细胞分化
验证· 通过成骨细胞培养实验进行形态和生化评价
English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of very rough surface from SLM and additional bioactive treatment on osteoblast proliferation and differentiation for titanium implants.
Method· Flat-rolled titanium (Ra=1.02 µm) and SLM-fabricated titanium (Ra=24.58 µm) were compared with and without bioactive treatment.
Result· Bioactive treatment significantly enhanced osteoblast differentiation on SLM-fabricated titanium, whereas untreated SLM surface did not outperform flat-rolled titanium.
Validation· In vitro osteoblast cell culture with morphological and biochemical assays.

Open-porous biodegradable magnesium scaffolds produced by selective laser melting for individualized bone replacement.

Witte Frank, Lucas Jauer, Meiners Wolfgang, Kronbach Zienab, Strohschein Kristin et al. Frontiers in Bioengineering and Biotechnology 2016-01-01 10.3389/conf.fbioe.2016.01.00708
相关性: 该研究涉及SLM制备可降解镁支架，但未关注应力屏蔽或疲劳性能，与本方向的核心需求不完全一致。
边界: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it include fatigue testing or report osseointegration.
动机· 探索选择性激光熔化制备个性化可降解镁骨支架的可行性。
方法· 采用SLM工艺加工WE43镁合金粉末，改变工艺参数并分析显微组织及腐蚀行为。
结果· 通过喷砂可得到致密支柱，腐蚀速率与能量输入线性相关。
验证· 体外腐蚀试验、力学压缩测试及细胞毒性验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the feasibility of selective laser melting for fabricating individualized biodegradable magnesium bone scaffolds.
Method· WE43 magnesium alloy powder was processed by SLM with varied process parameters, and the resulting specimens were characterized by SEM, EDS, and light microscopy.
Result· Sandblasted parts achieved nearly dense struts with thickness down to 300 µm, and the corrosion rate in HANKS solution was linearly dependent on energy input.
Validation· In vitro corrosion tests in a perfusion bioreactor, biomechanical compression tests, and cytocompatibility assays with human osteoblasts were performed.

Deformation Behavior and Microstructure of Ti6Al4V Manufactured by SLM

Pavel Krakhmalev, Gunnel Fredriksson, Ina Yadroitsava, Н. В. Казанцева, Anton du Plessis et al. Physics Procedia 2016-01-01 10.1016/j.phpro.2016.08.080
单位: Karlstad University, Department of Engineering and Physics, Karlstad SE-651 88, Sweden
通讯: Pavel Krakhmalev @ Karlstad University, Department of Engineering and Physics, Karlstad SE-651 88, Sweden
相关性: 该论文为SLM制造Ti6Al4V的力学性能和微观结构提供了基础数据，但未涉及应力屏蔽或骨整合等植入物关键问题。
边界: This paper does not evaluate stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration, all of which are critical for biomedical implant design.
动机· 分析SLM制造Ti6Al4V的力学性能和微观结构。
方法· 进行XRD、TEM、CT和拉伸测试。
结果· 发现完全马氏体α'结构，胞孔聚集导致断裂。
验证· 通过微CT和断口形貌验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the mechanical properties and microstructure of Ti6Al4V fabricated by selective laser melting.
Method· X-ray diffraction, transmission electron microscopy, computed tomography, and tensile testing were conducted.
Result· A fully martensitic α' structure with high dislocation density and twinning was observed, and pore coalescence was identified as the main crack formation mechanism.
Validation· Micro CT scans and fracture morphology analysis confirmed the deformation and failure mechanisms.

Validation· Experimental compression testing to validate mechanical properties.

Constitutive Modeling of Additive Manufactured Ti-6Al-4V Cyclic Elastoplastic Behaviour

Kyriakos I. Kourousis, Dylan Agius, Chunhui Wang, Aleksandar Subic Swinburne Research Bank (Swinburne University of Technology) 2016-01-01 10.24352/ub.ovgu-2017-010
相关性: 该论文研究SLM Ti-6Al-4V的循环弹塑性行为，与生物医学植入物材料相关，但未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡。
边界: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding, does not report surface roughness or osseointegration, and does not test biomedical implants specifically.
动机· 为增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能提供本构模型基础
方法· 对SLM试样进行单轴应力/应变控制试验，并用循环塑性模型模拟
结果· 模型成功再现了平均应力松弛和棘轮效应等疲劳相关现象
验证· 通过与试验数据对比验证本构模型准确性
English summary & terms
Motivation· To characterize the cyclic elastoplastic behavior of SLM Ti-6Al-4V for fatigue qualification in aerospace and biomedical applications.
Method· Uniaxial stress- and strain-controlled tests were conducted on as-built SLM coupons, and cyclic plasticity models were employed to simulate the test results.

English summary & terms

Validation· Validation relied on mechanical testing (tensile tests) with statistical analysis (F-test and t-test) to compare manufacturing methods.

Motivation· To enhance osseointegration of Ti6Al4V implants by applying a piezoelectric barium titanate coating.
Method· Barium titanate coating was fabricated on Ti6Al4V via electrophoretic deposition using sol-gel-synthesized nanopowder.

Motivation· This study proposes sheep as an experimental model for evaluating the bioactive capacity of bone substitute biomaterials and implant systems, based on literature review and personal experience.
Method· The authors reviewed relevant databases and supplemented with their own experience, discussing stages of sheep experiments including breeding, maintenance, and specimen processing.

English summary & terms
Motivation· This study aims to determine the optimal method for coating bone sialoprotein onto titanium orthopedic implants to enhance osseointegration.
Method· BSP was covalently coupled via APTES or physisorbed onto titanium disks, and primary human osteoblasts and L929 fibroblasts were cultured to assess adhesion, migration, proliferation, and mineralization.

Motivation· To investigate whether local injection of nerve growth factor can improve osseointegration of titanium implants in type 2 diabetic rats.
Method· Goto-Kakizaki diabetic rats received titanium implants in the tibia and were treated with daily intramuscular injections of nerve growth factor or saline for 7 days, with histological analysis at 2, 4, and 8 weeks.

English summary & terms
Motivation· Metal-on-metal hip bearings release metal debris causing adverse reactions, motivating the development of a ceramic coating to reduce ion release.
Method· An ovine total hip arthroplasty model compared SLC-coated metal-on-metal, uncoated metal-on-metal, and metal-on-polyethylene bearings for wear and metal ion levels.
Result· The SLC coating significantly lowered blood chromium and cobalt levels compared to uncoated metal-on-metal, with no coating delamination or adverse reactions.
Validation· Validation was performed using an in vivo sheep model with CMM, SEM, blood ion analysis, MRI, and histological scoring.

Motivation· To evaluate the success rate and stability development of photofunctionalized dental implants with low or extremely low primary stability.

Method· Linear regression analysis was performed between torque measurements and actual densities of polyurethane foam blocks under irrigated and non-irrigated conditions.

Validation· Mechanical testing on standard density polyurethane foam blocks.

方法· 前瞻性临床研究，测量植入扭矩和稳定性系数，分析骨吸收相关性。
结果· 高扭矩(≥50Ncm)在3年随访中未引起显著的边缘骨吸收。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate whether high insertion torque during dental implant placement has negative effects on crestal bone levels over a 3-year period.
Method· A prospective multicenter clinical study measured insertion torque and implant stability quotient, and correlated these with radiographic crestal bone loss via linear regression.
Result· High insertion torque (≥50 Ncm) did not correlate with increased early or 3-year crestal bone loss, and implant success rate was 98.6%.
Validation· Clinical follow-up of 3 years with radiographic assessment and statistical regression.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To compare the primary stability and osseointegration of tapered versus cylindrical dental implants in a minipig model.
Method· Tapered and cylindrical implants were placed in minipig mandibles, with insertion torque, implant stability, and histomorphometric analysis performed.
Result· No significant differences were observed between tapered and cylindrical implants in stability or bone-to-implant contact.
Validation· Validation through insertion torque, implant stability quotient, and histomorphometric analysis in an animal model.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate sclerostin expression in bone healing around titanium implants with and without primary stability.
Method· Titanium implants were placed in rat tibiae with either primary stability or instability, and sclerostin-positive cells were quantified by immunohistochemistry at 7, 14, and 21 days.
Result· Sclerostin expression was significantly higher around unstable implants at early time points, indicating a role in osseointegration failure.
Validation· In vivo animal study using Wistar rats with immunohistochemical analysis.

Hydroxyapatite in total hip arthroplasty. Our experience with a plasma spray porous titanium alloy/hydroxyapatite double-coated cementless stem.

Iacopo Castellini, Lorenzo Andreani, Paolo Domenico Parchi, Enrico Bonicoli, Nicola Piolanti et al. Clinical cases in mineral and bone metabolism : the official journal of the Italian Society of Osteoporosis, Mineral Metabolism, and Skeletal Diseases 2016-01-01 10.11138/ccmbm/2016.13.3.221
单位: Orthopaedics and Traumatology 1st Department, University of Pisa, Pisa, Italy.
通讯: Michele Lisanti @ Orthopaedics and Traumatology 1st Department, University of Pisa, Pisa, Italy. [推断]
相关性: 该论文仅报告临床结果，未涉及应力遮挡、微动或有限元分析等生物力学量化内容，与用户研究方向无关。
边界: This paper reports clinical outcomes only, with no biomechanical modeling, no quantification of stress shielding or micromotion, no finite element analysis, and no comparison of intact vs implanted femur.
动机· 评估多孔钛合金/羟基磷灰石双涂层无骨水泥股骨柄的中期临床和影像学结果。
方法· 回顾性分析240例全髋关节置换术患者的Harris髋关节评分、WOMAC评分和X线影像。
结果· 术后平均40个月假体存活率100%，下沉率1.64%，无放射学透亮线。
验证· 临床随访结合Harris髋关节评分和X线影像评估。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the mid-term clinical and radiographic outcomes of a plasma-sprayed porous titanium alloy/hydroxyapatite double-coated cementless femoral stem.
Method· A retrospective analysis of 240 primary THAs assessed Harris Hip Scores, WOMAC scores, and serial radiographs for stem subsidence and radiolucencies.
Result· At a mean follow-up of 40 months, implant survival was 100%, stem subsidence >2 mm occurred in 1.64% of cases (all Dorr type C), with no proximal radiolucencies.
Validation· Clinical outcomes and radiographic review were used to evaluate implant survival and osseointegration.

动机· 评估不同骨上水平牙种植体的愈合稳定性。
方法· 回顾性研究，使用共振频率分析测量ISQ值。
结果· 植入深度影响初期稳定性，直径和部位影响稳定性，长度无关。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the healing stability of dental implants placed at different supracrestal levels.
Method· A retrospective study using resonance frequency analysis to measure implant stability quotient (ISQ) over 12 weeks.
Result· Deeper implant placement improved primary stability; implant diameter and site (jaw) affected stability, while length did not when diameter was accounted for.
Validation· Clinical data from 103 implants in patients.
